message.content:
Based on the images provided, here are the precise answers to your questions:

**1) Is image 1 showing the exact same view as image 2? List ALL UI chrome visible in image 1.**
*   **Yes**, Image 1 shows the exact same core diagram and layout as Image 2 (same "Steam-Methane Reforming Plant" process flow). However, **Image 1 is a cropped view** that excludes the main application header and the right-hand sidebar.
*   **UI Chrome Visible in Image 1:**
    *   **Top Bar:** A thin instruction bar reading: *"Drag to pan - scroll to zoom - click any unit or stream"*.
    *   **Diagram Containers:** Three distinct rectangular border boxes enclosing the process sections.
    *   **Bottom-Left:** A circular **'N' compass** icon.
    *   **Bottom-Left (Legend):** Text labels for **"FEED"**, **"PROCESS GAS"** (with solid blue line), **"CONDENSATE"** (with dashed line), and **"CO2"** (with dashed line).
    *   **Bottom-Right Controls:** Zoom controls (**"-"**, **"+"**) and a **"FIT"** button.
    *   **Diagram Label (Bottom-Right of canvas):** A small box titled **"AMMONIA SYNTHESIS"** with subtext **"PROCESS FLOW DIAGRAM"**.

**2) Do the three process sections sit on separate raised boxes/cards with gaps between them, or on one continuous sheet?**
They sit on **three separate raised boxes (cards)**. There are clear visual gaps (negative space) separating the "1 - FEED & REFORMING" box, the "2 - SHIFT & PURIFICATION" box, and the larger "3 - SYNTHESIS LOOP & COMPRESSION" box below them.

**3) Where exactly does the 'N' compass appear?**
It appears in the **bottom-left corner** of the interface, floating over the dark background just below the start of the process diagram (near the K-102 Circulator).

**4) Any 3D perspective in image 1, or is it a flat 2D drawing?**
It is a **flat 2D drawing**. There are no vanishing points or perspective foreshortening; all equipment symbols (tanks, valves, lines) are rendered in a strict 2D schematic/orthographic style.
